locations.note: Dalian Plant: an invented battle over a coastal nuclear plant near the port of Dalian.
Daqing Oilfields: the pumpjacks and pipelines of the oil city, a multiplayer map.
Songhua Stalemate: a swamp fight along the river in Manchuria, a multiplayer map.
Dragon Valley and FuShe Pass: a river valley and a mountain pass somewhere in China, two multiplayer maps.
Great Wall: the Euro Force map fought along the wall itself.
Gulf of Oman: a beach landing against the Middle Eastern Coalition on the Omani coast, a multiplayer map.
Wake Island 2007: the 1942 atoll refought with modern armies.
Road to Jalalabad: the Armored Fury map in the Afghan city.
Midnight Sun: the Armored Fury map in the Alaskan tundra.
Operation Harvest: the Armored Fury map through Pennsylvania farmland.
